Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public.

FOREWORD 

This  Indian  Standard  was  adopted  by  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  on  7  August  1989,  after  the 
draft  finalized  by  the  Sewing  Machines  Sectional  Committee  had  been  approved  by  the  Light  Mechani- 
cal Engineering  Division  CounciL 

While  preparing  the  standard  assistance  has  been  derived  from  JISB  9053-1963  'Specification  for  treadle 
driven  (  stand  )  for  sewing  machine  for  home  use'  issued  by  Japanese  Industrial  Standards  Committee. 


IS  12740  :  1989 


Indian  Standard 


HOUSEHOLD  SEWING  MACHINES  -  STAND 

SPECIFICATION 


1  SCOPE 

l.l  This  standard  lays  down  ihe  requirements  for 
stand,  a  treadle  driving  equipment,  used  with 
common  type  tables  of  sewing  machines  for 
household  purposes, 

2  REFERENCES 

IS  No,  Title 

210  :  1978  Grey   iron  castings    {thftd 

revision  ) 

1570  (  Part  2  )  ;  1979  Schedules  for  wv^ought 
steels:  Part  2  Carbon  steel 
(  unalloyed  steel  ) 

3  NOMENCLATURE 

3,1  Nomenclature  shall  be  as  shown  in  Fig.  L 

4  MATERIALS 

4.1  Cast  iron  parts  shall  be  manufactured  from 
cast  iron  corresponding  to  FG  150  of  IS  210: 
1978. 

4.2  Steel  parts  shall  be  manufactured  from  any 
suitable  steel,  such  as  20C8  or  40C8  of  IS  1570 
(Part  2):  1979. 

5  HARDNESS 

5.1  Bearing  surface  of  band  wheel  crank  and 
hingepins  for  treadle  shall  have  a  nsinimum 
hardness  of400HV, 

6  DIMENSIONS 

6.1  Dimensions  of  main  parts  shall  conform  to 
the  following: 

Height  of  leg  ( including  rollers  )  720  mm,  Min 
Width  of  brace  495  mm,  Min 

Diameter  of  band  wheel  420  mm,  Min 

(  boiiom  ol  bell  groove  ) 

Size  of  treadle  300  mm  x  225  mm. 

7  WORKMANSHIP  AND  FINISH 

7.1  Wheel  groove  and  wheel  rim  sliall  have  a 
smooth  tiitish. 

7.2  Parts  shall  be  assembled  iirmly  and  shall 
function  satisfactorily. 


7.3  Band  wheel  crank  shall  function  smoothly 
with  minimum  play. 

7.4  Treadle  shall  function  smoothly  with  minimum 
play. 

7.5  All  the  hinge  and  bearing  parts  shall  be 
properly  lubricated. 

7.6  All  the  legs  shall  be  titled  with  rollers.  The 
rollers  shall  turn  smoothly  and  all  the  four  legs 
shall  sit  firmly  on  the  floor- 

7.7  Belt  shifter  and  belt  guide  shall  be  properly 
located  and  belt  shifter  with  spring  shall  function 
satisfactorily. 

7.8  Band  wheel  shall  have  a  projection  for  the 
purpose  of  hooking-up  the  belt  and  this  projection 
shall  function  satisfactorily. 

7.9  All  parts  shall  be  sufficiently  strong  and  rigid. 

7.10  Castings  shall  be  free  from  detrimental 
defects  suc^  as  sand-drops,  blow  holes,  cracks, 
pins,  burrs,  etc.  Castings  shall  be  painted  with 
stoving  paint  and  shall  be  oven  baked.  The  paint 
coating  shall  be  smooth  and  free  from  run,  dust, 
mars,  peeling,  etc. 

8  MARKING 

8.1  The  stand  may  be  marked  with  manufacturer's 
name  or  trade-mark. 

9  PACKING 

9.1  Each  item  of  the  painted  c:ist  iron  compo- 
nent  shall  be  wrapped  separately  in  paper/polyethy- 
lene bag  after  proper  cleaning  and  removing 
dust,  etc.  in  such  a  manner  that  no  dust  can 
enter  it. 

9.2  All  the  hardware  item,  pitman  bearing,  etc, 
shall  be  packed  in  a  polyethylene  bag. 

9.3  Wrapped  items  of  the  stand  shall  be  packed 
in  a  strong  wooden  box  along  with  a  spanner  as 
per  best  prevailing  practice  in  the  trade.  The 
number  of  stand  Sets  to  be  packed  in  a  packing 
case  shall  be  us  agreed  to  between  the  supplier 
and  the  purchaser.

Fic.  1    Nomenclature  of  Household  Sewing  Machine  Stand  (  Treadle  Driving  Equipment  ) 


Srandard  Mark 

The  use  of  the  Standard  Mark  is  governed  by  the  provisions  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian 
Standards  Act,  1986  and  the  Rules  and  Regulations  made  thereunder.  The  Standard  Mark  on 
products  covered  by  an  Indian  Standard  conveys  the  assurance  that  they  have  been  produced 
to  comply  with  the  requirements  of  that  standard  under  a  well  defined  system  of  inspection, 
testing  and  quality  control  which  is  devised  and  supervised  by  BIS  and  operated  by  the 
producer.  Standard  marked  products  arc  also  continuously  checked  by  BIS  for  conformity 
to  that  standard  as  a  further  safeguard.  Details  of  conditions  under  which  a  licence  for  the 
use  of  the  Standard  Mark  may  be  granted  to  manufacturers  or  producers  may  be  obtained 
from  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards. 


Bareaa  of  Indian  Standards 

BIS  is  a  statutory  institution  established  under  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  Act,  1986  to  promote 
harmonious  development  of  the  activities  of  standardization,  marking  and  quality  certification  of  goods 
and  attending  to  connected  matters  in  the  country. 

Copyright 

BIS  has  the  copyright  of  all  its  publications.  No  part  of  these  pubhcations  may  be  reproduced  in 
any  form  without  the  prior  permission  in  writing  of  BIS.  This  does  not  preclude  the  free  use,  in  the 
course  of  implementing  the  standard,  of  necessary  details,  such  as  symbols  and  sizes,  type  or  grade 
designations.     Enquiries  relating  to  copyright  be  addressed  to  the  Director  (  Publications  ),  BIS. 

Revision  of  Indian  Standards 

Indian  Standards  are  reviewed  periodically  and  revised,  when  necessary  and  amendments,  ii  any,  arc 
issued  from  time  to  time.  Users  of  Indian  Standards  should  ascertain  that  they  are  in  possession  of 
the  latest  amendments  or  edition.  Comments  on  this  Indian  Standard  may  be  sent  to  BIS  giving  the 
following  reference: 

Doc  :  No.  LMD  18  (  5224  )
